as_told.title: Imperial College DMT research mapping the spirit world

plain: Researchers at Imperial College, a university in London, are said to have found a way to keep people in the state brought on by DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug whose effects normally last only minutes, for much longer, around 30 minutes. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore says Imperial College, with the researcher Chris Timmermann, picked up the idea and built a much better method, and that every subject in the trials got through it without serious problems. The writer Graham Hancock says they can keep people in the state for an hour. Michels describes the work as Gallimore and Imperial College mapping the spirit world, which is what it would mean to its believers if true.
